verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing does expose a Meter Events API for usage-based billing, letting customers stream usage actions like API calls into a metering pipeline (docs-28, docs-29), and the general API supports idempotency keys as a platform-wide feature, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of idempotent ingestion semantics or backdating support for meter events specifically. Missing for 10: explicit idempotency-key handling for meter events, backdated event timestamp support, and high-volume streaming architecture guidance/benchmarks.
